subject: jailer's ring
fact: A jailer's ring with iron keys, each worn smooth from years of use, was found.
source_quote: The keys were the first thing I noticed. A jailer's ring, iron and heavy, each key worn smooth from years of use.

subject: chest of coin
fact: A chest of coin containing Velkynvelve's operational budget in gold and silver was discovered.
source_quote: The payroll was next — a chest of coin, Velkynvelve's operational budget rendered in gold and silver.

subject: prisoner belongings chest
fact: The confiscated prisoner belongings chest contained personal items, including Thorin's tooth and other artifacts of ownership.
source_quote: Confiscated prisoner belongings. Ilvara had been carrying it. ... I opened it, and the contents were exactly what you would expect from someone who understood that stripping a prisoner of their possessions is the first act of stripping them of themselves.

subject: Thorin's tooth
fact: Thorin retrieved his tooth from the confiscated prisoner belongings chest.
source_quote: He reached in and found it.

subject: water-damaged journal
fact: A water-damaged journal from an unnamed prisoner, with swollen pages and running ink, was found.
source_quote: We also found a water-damaged journal from a prisoner we would never meet — someone who had written things down and then, presumably, stopped being able to.

subject: flask of Overbright brandy
fact: A flask of Overbright brandy was recovered and received with personal interest.
source_quote: The flask of Overbright brandy I received with considerably more personal interest.

subject: holy symbol of Lolth
fact: A holy symbol of Lolth was looted from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: chain mail
fact: Chain mail was looted from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: prayer beads
fact: Prayer beads were looted from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: sealed wax pouch
fact: A sealed wax pouch was taken from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: Drow cloak
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak made of fine spider-silk that drinks shadow from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: theological manuscript
fact: The sealed wax pouch contained pages of close, careful script detailing a theological exploration claiming Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same.
source_quote: Inside were pages of close, careful script — the handwriting of someone who had once been methodical, who had trained as a theologian and brought that training to bear on a question that should not have been asked. I read far enough to understand what it was, and then I looked up. 'It's basically a long theological exploration of why Zuggtmoy and Lolth — and claiming that Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same thing.'

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was a high priestess of Lolth who carried prisoner belongings as trophies and was subverted by Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Confiscated prisoner belongings. Ilvara had been carrying it. Of course she had — she was exactly the sort of high priestess who would keep trophies, who would drag along evidence of her ownership of people the way some clerics keep relics.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree was a cleric of Lolth who also became a cleric of Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Asha Vandree had been a cleric of Lolth who had also become, in some capacity, a cleric of Zuggtmoy.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took the Drow cloak from Asha Vandree's body.
source_quote: Zalthir took the Drow cloak she'd been wearing — the fine spider-silk kind that drinks shadow — and I did not begrudge him that.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin retrieved his tooth from the confiscated prisoner belongings chest.
source_quote: He reached in and found it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was cataloguing the room and paying attention to the implications of the recovered items.
source_quote: Daz looked over from where he was already cataloguing the rest of the room. ... Daz was paying attention in the way he pays attention to things — still, cataloguing, already working the implications.

subject: Gorg'Bahamut
fact: Gorg'Bahamut was the narrator's mentor who would have wanted a pious remark about the dignity of the dead.
source_quote: My mentor Gorg'Bahamut would have wanted me to.

subject: Ilvara's prayer book
fact: Ilvara's prayer book was a standard Lolth devotional text with marginalia in a different hand documenting her corruption by Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Ilvara's prayer book was still on the body when we got to her. ... The main text was a standard Lolth prayer book ... The marginalia told the story. ... a different hand ... since it shows the corruption timeline.

subject: corruption timeline
fact: The marginalia in Ilvara's prayer book documented a gradual corruption timeline from orthodox Lolth worship to Zuggtmoy influence.
source_quote: The marginalia told the story. ... The early entries were neat and formal ... Then, gradually, around the margins, a second voice crept in. ... The corruption timeline was legible if you knew how to read it.

subject: Tongued merchant reference
fact: The narrator recalled a merchant once Tongued by a bardic curse whose correspondence mirrored Ilvara's marginalia.
source_quote: I had seen something like this before, in a completely different context — a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse, whose correspondence from that period was eerily similar.

subject: sealed orders from House Mizzrym
fact: Sealed orders from House Mizzrym were found, asking where Ilvara was and expressing increasing urgency.
source_quote: The sealed orders from House Mizzrym were more immediately practical ... 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing. You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?'

subject: letter from Neverlight Grove
fact: A letter from Neverlight Grove was found, referencing a missed meeting with Ilvara.
source_quote: The letter from Neverlight Grove completed the picture, in a grim sort of way. A missed meeting. Political correspondence that had gone nowhere, because the person it was addressed to had gone somewhere else.

subject: Living Serpent Head Scourge
fact: A Living Serpent Head Scourge, with a head that was a living serpent in an intermediate state between alive and not, was found on Ilvara's body.
source_quote: The last item was on Ilvara herself. 'The Living Serpent Head Scourge sounds...' ... a scourge whose head was an actual living serpent, or had been, in some intermediate state between alive and not.

subject: Drow outpost
fact: The Drow outpost contained a jailer's ring, a chest of coin, a prisoner belongings chest, a water-damaged journal, a flask of brandy, Asha Vandree's remains, Ilvara's body, and various documents and artifacts.
source_quote: The keys were the first thing I noticed... The payroll was next... Then I saw the other chest... We also found a water-damaged journal... The flask of Overbright brandy... Asha Vandree's body was next... Ilvara's prayer book was still on the body... The sealed orders from House Mizzrym... The letter from Neverlight Grove... The last item was on Ilvara herself.

subject: looting Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree's body was looted, yielding a holy symbol of Lolth, chain mail, prayer beads, and a sealed wax pouch.
source_quote: I looted her with the efficient respect one extends to a theological problem that has been resolved. The holy symbol of Lolth. Chain mail. Prayer beads. And a sealed wax pouch.

subject: opening the wax pouch
fact: The sealed wax pouch was opened and revealed a theological manuscript claiming Lolth and Zuggtmoy are the same.
source_quote: The seal broke cleanly. Inside were pages of close, careful script — the handwriting of someone who had once been methodical... I read far enough to understand what it was...

subject: examining Ilvara's prayer book
fact: Ilvara's prayer book was examined and revealed marginalia in a different hand documenting her corruption by Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: I'll examine it gingerly... The main text was a standard Lolth prayer book... The marginalia told the story. A different hand... The early entries were neat... Then, gradually, around the margins, a second voice crept in.

subject: retrieving Thorin's tooth
fact: Thorin retrieved his tooth from the confiscated prisoner belongings chest.
source_quote: He reached in and found it.

subject: reading sealed orders from House Mizzrym
fact: The sealed orders from House Mizzrym were read aloud, revealing urgent inquiries about Ilvara's disappearance.
source_quote: I read them aloud, more or less: 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing. You've gone missing. Followed by more frantic: where are you, where are you? Didn't you read the previous memo? What's up?'

subject: recovering the Living Serpent Head Scourge
fact: The Living Serpent Head Scourge was set aside as a museum piece after being found on Ilvara's body.
source_quote: I set it aside with the other items. The prayer book. The wax pouch. The sealed orders. The serpent scourge.

subject: Stroud and Protanther reference
fact: The narrator recalled Stroud sitting across from Protanther as an example of a blind spot in long-term preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: House Mizzrym
fact: House Mizzrym sent sealed orders seeking Ilvara's whereabouts after her disappearance.
source_quote: The sealed orders from House Mizzrym were more immediately practical... 'Where are you? What have you been doing? Respond — kind of thing.'

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: Neverlight Grove sent a letter to Ilvara referencing a missed meeting.
source_quote: The letter from Neverlight Grove completed the picture... A missed meeting. Political correspondence that had gone nowhere...

subject: unknown
fact: The timeline of Ilvara's corruption spans years, beginning with her early career as a high priestess.
source_quote: Ilvara had presumably carried it since early in her career, which meant it was old, which meant she had been using it as a devotional object for years before something began to change.

subject: Stroud
fact: Stroud is referenced as having sat across from Protanther after four hundred years of preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: Protanther
fact: Protanther is referenced as the individual Stroud sat across from after four hundred years of preparation.
source_quote: I thought, briefly, of Stroud sitting down across from Protanther. Four hundred years of preparation. Still had a blind spot.

subject: Tongue of Madness mushroom
fact: The narrator's notes on the Tongued merchant imply the use of a Tongue of Madness mushroom as the cause of altered correspondence.
source_quote: a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse

subject: bardic curse
fact: A bardic curse is referenced as the cause of altered handwriting in the merchant's correspondence.
source_quote: a merchant I once knew who had been Tongued by a bardic curse
